Shiny app 
# currently works great 



```{r}
library(shiny)
library(shinyjs)
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

# Define state pairs with exact naming that matches your image files
state_pairs <- list(
  list(name = "NORTH CAROLINA_TENNESSEE", display_name = "North Carolina vs Tennessee", vis_type = "polar"),
  list(name = "MISSISSIPPI_LOUISIANA", display_name = "Mississippi vs Louisiana", vis_type = "overlaid"),
  list(name = "FLORIDA_DELAWARE", display_name = "Florida vs Delaware", vis_type = "dodged"), 
  list(name = "ALABAMA_GEORGIA", display_name = "Alabama vs Georgia", vis_type = "polar"),
  list(name = "MISSOURI_OHIO", display_name = "Missouri vs Ohio", vis_type = "overlaid")
)

ui <- fluidPage(
  useShinyjs(),
  div(
    id = "login_page",
    style = "width: 300px; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding-top: 50px;",
    wellPanel(
      h2("Enter Your Name", class = "text-center"),
      textInput("user_name", "Your Name:", placeholder = "First Last"),
      actionButton("login_btn", "Start Assessment", class = "btn-primary btn-block")
    )
  ),
  hidden(
    div(
      id = "explanation_page",
      style = "width: 800px; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding-top: 20px;",
      wellPanel(
        h2("Experiment Instructions", class = "text-center"),
        h3("Understanding Ratio Judgments"),
        p("In this experiment, you'll be comparing visualizations showing mental illness rates between pairs of states."),
        p("Your task is to estimate the ratio between the two states' values by adjusting the slider."),
        h3("Example"),
       imageOutput("example_chart", height = "400px"),
        p("For this example visualization, we want you to estimate the ratio of the number in 1860 to 1870"),
        sliderInput("example_ratio", "Example Ratio:", 
                   min = 0, max = 1, value = 0.5, step = 0.01),
        actionButton("submit_example", "Submit Example", class = "btn-primary"),
        
        hidden(
          div(
            id = "feedback_section",
            h3("Feedback"),
            textOutput("true_ratio_feedback"),
            actionButton("proceed_btn", "Proceed to Experiment", class = "btn-success")
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  hidden(
    div(
      id = "main_app",
      titlePanel("Image Ratio Assessment Tool"),
      sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
          h3(textOutput("welcome_message")),
          uiOutput("ratio_slider_ui"),
          actionButton("save_btn", "Save Assessment", class = "btn-primary"),
          br(), br(),
          actionButton("logout_btn", "Sign Out", class = "btn-warning"),
          br(), br(),
          h4("Completion Status"),
          textOutput("progress_text"),
          h4("Current Visualization:"),
          textOutput("current_vis_type")
        ),
        mainPanel(
          imageOutput("display_image", height = "500px")
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Database connection
  con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "assessments.db")
  
  output$example_chart <- renderImage({
  # Full path to your image
  list(
    src = "pair_plots_original_style/dodged_example.png",
    contentType = "image/png",
    width = "100%",
    alt = "Example dodged bar chart"
  )
}, deleteFile = FALSE)
  
  # Create fresh tables
  dbExecute(con, "
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
      user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_name TEXT UNIQUE,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )
  ")
  
  dbExecute(con, "
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assessments (
      assessment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER,
      pair_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      pair_display TEXT NOT NULL,
      vis_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      ratio REAL NOT NULL,
      judgment_num INTEGER NOT NULL,
      timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id)
    )
  ")
  
  # Reactive values
  user <- reactiveValues(id = NULL, name = NULL, authenticated = FALSE)
  current_pair_index <- reactiveVal(1)
  judgment_num <- reactiveVal(1)
  
  # Current pair info
  current_pair <- reactive({
    state_pairs[[current_pair_index()]]
  })
  
  
  # Dynamic slider
  output$ratio_slider_ui <- renderUI({
    req(user$authenticated)
    sliderInput("ratio_slider", 
               label = paste("Ratio for", current_pair()$display_name),
               min = 0, max = 1, value = 0.5, step = 0.01)
  })
  
  # Current visualization type
  output$current_vis_type <- renderText({
    paste("Type:", current_pair()$vis_type)
  })
  
  # Welcome message
  output$welcome_message <- renderText({
    req(user$authenticated)
    paste("Welcome,", user$name)
  })
  
  # Progress text
  output$progress_text <- renderText({
    req(user$authenticated)
    paste("Pair", current_pair_index(), "of", length(state_pairs),
          "- Judgment", judgment_num(), "of 3")
  })
  
  # True ratio feedback for example
  output$true_ratio_feedback <- renderText({
    "The true ratio for this example was 0.65. This is because the 1860 data had a count of 130 and the 1870 data had a count of 200. By taking 130/200, we get .65 making a true ratio of .65"
  })
  
  # Image display with thorough error checking (hidden from user)
  output$display_image <- renderImage({
    req(user$authenticated)
    
    pair <- current_pair()$name
    vis_type <- current_pair()$vis_type
    
    # Construct possible filename patterns
    base_name <- paste0("Mentally_Ill_", pair, "_", vis_type)
    possible_files <- c(
      paste0(base_name, ".png"),                   # Exact match
      paste0(gsub("_", " ", base_name), ".png"),   # With spaces
      paste0(tolower(base_name), ".png"),          # Lowercase
      paste0(toupper(base_name), ".png")           # Uppercase
    )
    
    # Check each possible file
    img_path <- NULL
    for (f in possible_files) {
      test_path <- file.path("pair_plots_original_style", f)
      if (file.exists(test_path)) {
        img_path <- test_path
        break
      }
    }
    
    if (!is.null(img_path)) {
      # Return found image
      list(
        src = img_path,
        contentType = "image/png",
        width = "100%",
        alt = paste(pair, "visualization")
      )
    } else {
      # Fallback image with error message
      list(
        src = "https://via.placeholder.com/600x400/ff0000/ffffff?text=Image+Not+Found",
        contentType = "image/png",
        width = "100%",
        alt = paste("Missing:", base_name, ".png")
      )
    }
  }, deleteFile = FALSE)
  
  # Login handler
  observeEvent(input$login_btn, {
    req(input$user_name)
    
    tryCatch({
      user$name <- trimws(input$user_name)
      if (user$name == "") stop("Please enter your name")
      
      # Find or create user
      user_exists <- dbGetQuery(con, 
                              "SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_name = ?",
                              params = list(user$name))
      
      if (nrow(user_exists) == 0) {
        dbExecute(con, "INSERT INTO users (user_name) VALUES (?)", 
                 params = list(user$name))
        user$id <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT last_insert_rowid()")[[1]]
      } else {
        user$id <- user_exists$user_id[1]
      }
      
      shinyjs::hide("login_page")
      shinyjs::show("explanation_page")
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Error:", e$message), type = "error")
    })
  })
  
  # Submit example handler
  observeEvent(input$submit_example, {
    shinyjs::show("feedback_section")
  })
  
  # Proceed to experiment handler
  observeEvent(input$proceed_btn, {
    user$authenticated <- TRUE
    shinyjs::hide("explanation_page")
    shinyjs::show("main_app")
    judgment_num(1)
  })
  
  # Save handler
  observeEvent(input$save_btn, {
    req(user$authenticated)
    
    tryCatch({
      # Save current judgment
      dbExecute(con,
               "INSERT INTO assessments 
                (user_id, pair_name, pair_display, vis_type, ratio, judgment_num) 
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
               params = list(
                 user$id,
                 current_pair()$name,
                 current_pair()$display_name,
                 current_pair()$vis_type,
                 input$ratio_slider,
                 judgment_num()
               ))
      
      # Update judgment counter
      if (judgment_num() < 3) {
        judgment_num(judgment_num() + 1)
      } else {
        # Move to next pair after 3 judgments
        if (current_pair_index() < length(state_pairs)) {
          current_pair_index(current_pair_index() + 1)
          judgment_num(1)
        } else {
          showNotification("All assessments completed!", type = "message")
          shinyjs::disable("save_btn")
        }
      }
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Save failed:", e$message), type = "error")
    })
  })
  
  # Logout handler
  observeEvent(input$logout_btn, {
    user$id <- NULL
    user$name <- NULL
    user$authenticated <- FALSE
    shinyjs::reset("login_page")
    shinyjs::show("login_page")
    shinyjs::hide("main_app")
    shinyjs::hide("explanation_page")
    current_pair_index(1)
    judgment_num(1)
  })
  
  # Cleanup
  onStop(function() {
    dbDisconnect(con)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
